key.name: material
key.description: What the top bar, the dock, menus and notifications stand on: frost is thick, milky glass with an even tint; prism has less tint, more colour and light along its edges; clear is the thinnest glass, which darkens by itself where text needs it.

key.name: solid
key.description: Draw every glass surface in the theme's solid colours. Nothing is blurred, which also saves power.

key.name: blur-frost
key.description: How deep Frost's blur is, as a share of its own: 0.5 is light, 1.5 deep.

key.name: blur-prism
key.description: How deep Prism's blur is, as a share of its own: 0.5 is light, 1.5 deep.

key.name: blur-clear
key.description: How deep Clear's blur is, as a share of its own: 0.5 is light, 1.5 deep.

key.name: tint-frost
key.description: How dense Frost's tint is, as a share of its own: 0.5 is clearer, 1.5 denser.

key.name: tint-prism
key.description: How dense Prism's tint is, as a share of its own: 0.5 is clearer, 1.5 denser.

key.name: tint-clear
key.description: How dense Clear's tint is, as a share of its own: 0.5 is clearer, 1.5 denser.
